Netanyahu Addresses UN, Accuses Turkey of Backing Hamas

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed the UN, accusing Turkey of backing Iran-backed Islamist group Hamas. He also stated that the Iranian government would be toppled by its own lies and corruption. The Jerusalem Post reported that Hamas, Hezbollah, and Iran's proxies are hoping for Netanyahu's defeat.
